attributes._cssText: .journey-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0px; padding-bottom: 16px; width: min(448px, -50px + 100vw); box-sizing: border-box; }.journey-map { margin: 0px 0px 16px !important; border-radius: var(--radius-lg) !important; }.journey-driver-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }.journey-driver-avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-surface-alt); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); flex-shrink: 0; border: 2px solid var(--border-avatar); }.journey-driver-info { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; }.journey-driver-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); }.journey-driver-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px; }.journey-arriving-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--color-green-light); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }.journey-code-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }.journey-code-label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; }.journey-code-value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: 0.15em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: var(--bg-surface-alt); padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }.journey-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; }.journey-driver-mode-header { margin-bottom: 14px; }.journey-mode-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); }.journey-mode-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px; }.passenger-tab { background: var(--bg-surface-alt); color: var(--text-typed); border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast); }.passenger-tab-active { background: var(--bg-active-tab); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }.passenger-tab-done { opacity: 0.7; }.tab-done-dot { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-green-light); }.journey-passenger-card { background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 4px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }.journey-passenger-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 0px; }.journey-passenger-avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-surface-alt); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); flex-shrink: 0; border: 2px solid var(--border-avatar); }.journey-passenger-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; }.journey-passenger-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-typed); }.journey-passenger-rating { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px; justify-content: left; }.journey-passenger-rating.no-rating { color: var(--text-secondary); opacity: 0.6; }.journey-confirmed-badge { margin-left: auto; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25); color: var(--color-green-light); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; flex-shrink: 0; }.journey-passenger-details { margin: 12px 0px 0px !important; }.detail-pin { display: inline-flex; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 4px; opacity: 0.6; }.journey-confirm-btn { flex: 2 1 0%; }.journey-confirm-done { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed !important; }.journey-next-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; }.journey-next-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast); }.journey-next-btn:active { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(0.97); }.journey-all-done { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary); padding: 8px 0px; text-align: right; width: 100%; }
